oliver: Quick thread  I'm drafting a tiny Optimize Toolkit FAQ: 'Micro-batching + KV prefetch recommendations for quantized runtimes'. Goal: 1 short decision paragraph, a 1-line migration note, and two tiny SDK snippets (Ruby + C#). Need a reviewer for anchors and a perf blurb.
mira: Love it. Keep examples <10 lines and use <model-name> placeholders so we don't hardcode internal names.
shawn: I can do the C# snippet and run a quick smoke against a Q4 build. I'll also check we're not referencing `batch_hint` (deprecated).
oliver: Draft decision para (short):
"Micro-batching boosts throughput when concurrent requests are common, but can add tail latency for single-user short sequences. On quantized kernels, enabling kv-prefetch may increase peak RAM; explicitly set kv_prefetch and benchmark representative workloads to choose the best defaults for your app."
mira: Migration blurb (1 line): "Previous examples assumed kv-prefetch enabled; with quantized kernels that can increase RAM. Explicitly set kv_prefetch and benchmark."
shawn: C# snippet (short, will test):
```csharp
// pseudocode - redwood-csharp
var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_API_KEY"));
var req = new GenerationRequest { Model = "<model-name>", MaxTokens = 48, Batching = new MicroBatch { MaxBatchTokens = 256 }, KVPrefetch = false };
var resp = client.Generate(req);
Console.WriteLine(resp.Text);
```
mira: Ruby snippet (tiny):
```ruby
# pseudocode - redwood-rb
client = Redwood::Client.new(ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model: '<model-name>', max_tokens: 48, batching: { type: 'micro', max_batch_tokens: 256 }, kv_prefetch: false)
puts resp.text
```
shawn: Perf note from quick run: for short prompts and 1-3 users, single-request streaming is lower latency; micro-batching helps on sustained concurrency. I'll add that as a one-sentence recommendation.
docs-bot: Reminder: include samplegen metadata (opt/microbatch-quant) and run code-block linting per CONTRIBUTING.md. Also confirm the quant doc anchor before linking.
mira: I checked anchors; the stable anchor is currently `#quant-recommendations`. I'll point the cross-ref to /optimize/quant-profiles.md#quant-recommendations in the PR.
oliver: Thanks all  opening a WIP PR with snippets and samplegen stub, tagging @mira @shawn for review. Targeting merge after quick lint + small perf sanity checks. :rocket:
